result.summary: Found 1 issue: low-contrast text in the promotional banner reduces readability.

issues.description: The promotional banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and especially the smaller 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' subtext) appears in white or very light gray against a light mint-green background, resulting in poor contrast that is difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Increase the text contrast by using a darker color (e.g., dark teal or charcoal) on the light banner, or place the text on a slightly darker/overlay panel so it remains legible while preserving the brand color.
